title: Navigation Unit
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA LAND.DLA LAND WARREN MICHIGAN.DLA LAND WARREN
detail_text: Synopsis – SPRDL1-26-R-0005 ***************************************************************************************** The Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support (Warren) anticipates issuing a solicitation that will result in a Firm-Fixed Price contract for the following item: Item: Navigation Unit (ATALIN Kit with Container) NSN: 6605-01-705-8418 PPN: 13056442 Quantity: 81 Kits Option: 1 year, 100% FOB: Destination The subject solicitation is Sole Source. The Technical Data Package will only be available to the Sole Source Manufacturer. The solicitation should be released to the web on or about 17 April 2026. See the solicitation for actual closing date. Once available, the solicitation can be downloaded from SAM.gov (https://www.SAM.gov). If you have any questions, please contact the Contract Specialist, Kimberly Houghton, at (586) 230-8521 or by email at kimberly.houghton@dla.mil.
